verdict.rationale: cubic documents its own natural-language chat: you can select code and ask about it with the diff and codebase as context, ask follow-up questions in PR comments, and reply to review comments for clarification. This is framed around understanding and reviewing PR changes rather than debugging or troubleshooting a reported issue. missing for 10: documented debugging/troubleshooting workflows driven by natural-language queries (e.g., diagnosing a bug or error outside a PR diff), examples of troubleshooting use, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug issues and troubleshoot using natural-language queries

citations.quote: Select code and choose **Add to AI chat** to ask about it with the diff and codebase as context.
Ask follow-up questions about code changes without leaving the PR
Reply to a review comment to ask for clarification
Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues.
